command: set -u; echo ===IDENTITY===; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo ===TMUX===; tmux ls 2>&1 || true; echo ===PROCESSES===; pgrep -af omega || true; echo ===RUNTIME_DIRS===; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime /workspace/omega_runtime/current /workspace/oMEGA; do if [ -e $p ]; then printf '%s ' $p; stat -c '%F %U:%G %a' $p; else echo MISSING_$p; fi; done; echo ===HEADS===; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime/current /workspace/oMEGA; do if [ -d $p/.git ]; then echo REPO=$p; git -C $p rev-parse HEAD; git -C $p status --porcelain=v1 -uno; fi; done; echo ===RELEASE===; if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/CURRENT_RELEASE.json ]; then cat /workspace/omega_runtime/CURRENT_RELEASE.json; else echo NO_CURRENT_RELEASE; fi; echo ===SUPERVISOR_STATUS===; if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json ]; then cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json; else echo NO_SUPERVISOR_STATUS; fi; echo ===GRID_STATUS===; if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/state/STATUS.json ]; then cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/STATUS.json; else echo NO_GRID_STATUS; fi; echo ===MASTER_ERROR===; if [ -f /workspace/omega_runtime/state/master_bridge/LAST_ERROR.json ]; then cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/master_bridge/LAST_ERROR.json; else echo NO_MASTER_ERROR; fi; echo ===MASTER_DIR_COUNTS===; for p in /workspace/omega_runtime/state/master_bridge/submitted /workspace/omega_runtime/state/master_bridge/responses /workspace/omega_runtime/state/master_bridge/submitted_messages /workspace/omega_runtime/state/outbox; do printf '%s=' $p; if [ -d $p ]; then find $p -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l; else echo MISSING; fi; done; echo ===CARRIER===; if [ -d /workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo/.git ]; then echo CARRIER_PRESENT; git -C /workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo rev-parse HEAD; git -C /workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo status --porcelain=v1 -uno; else echo CARRIER_MISSING; fi
